323-574-1981-2415.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
323-574-1981-2415.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1251-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-4687-6006.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4687-6006.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-2907-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-7084-7422.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

225-2557-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1742-2438-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-2438-5003-7848.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
1742-2438-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

2921-2946-3220-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

206-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1824-2530-4668-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4668-7350.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1824-2530-4668-7350.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-4742-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-3967-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1400-1600-5339.description: Because Sandwurm Convergence prevents creatures with flying from attacking you, and Teferi's Moat prevents creatures without flying from attacking you (as they're all the named color due to Darkest Hour), no creatures can attack you.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7153.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

3967-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2921-3025-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3129-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Primal Vigor.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
3129-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1479-2638-2841-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2638-2841-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

483-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-4927.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-4927.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

539-2783-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

510-2281-2511.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1069-1849-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1849-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

804-1479-2232.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
804-1479-2232.description:
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 3 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 5, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 2, putting the permanent you returned in step 6 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

681-1644-4423-4693-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1644-4423-4693-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, causing you to gain 12 life.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

698-2450-4050-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-2450-4050-4258.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {2}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {U}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

163-678-2452.description:
Cast Diver Skaab by paying {0}.
When Diver Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Diver Skaab dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4013-4471-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature.
4013-4471-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Great Desert Prospector.
Great Desert Prospector enters the battlefield, creating at least two tapped Powerstone artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Powerstones, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2201-3972.description:
Godhead of Awe causes all other creatures to have base power and toughness of 1/1.
Ethereal Absolution gives all creatures your opponent control -1/-1.
Any creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control will do so as a 0/0 creature, and will die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.

301-687-1628-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Necrosynthesis.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Putrid Goblin.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Putrid Goblin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-824-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
129-824-4474.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may choose to add other colors of mana, and use the mana to activate Kinnan's ability.

738-1969-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, Grave Pact and Su-Chi trigger.
Resolve Su-Chi's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's ability, causing each other player to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers once for each creature that dies this way, causing you to return Su-Chi (and possibly additional artifact cards) from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat until your opponents control no creatures.
Repeat each turn.
